- Observe opponents and adapt.

I need to decide on an auction bid for North Carolina Avenue.

I have $726 and a strong pink monopoly. I am considering whether to bid aggressively for North Carolina Avenue.

p4 currently leads the auction at $67. I will bid $68 to block them from completing a PA+NC pair. If they push past my cap, I will drop out.

Mortgaging North Carolina Avenue would return $150, giving a net gain of $82. Pacific Avenue is owned by p1 and mortgaged, so p4 cannot complete a green monopoly even if they win. The bid is mainly to deny them a foothold.

I checked the rent values for dark blue properties. Park Place with three houses pays $1,100. Boardwalk with three houses pays $1,400. I need a cash buffer to cover these amounts. Selling all twelve pink houses would return about $600.
